title: Unit Event — Find A Way Out

meta.Outline: Tis the season to be jolly and Vivid BAD SQUAD is all gathered at Weekend Garage. They discuss performing at the live house where RADder debuted, but Akito seems to have some history with said venue...

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, had Tono said anything?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Yeah!
He said we should get started and that he'll be here soon.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, you all ready?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, we're ready.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: So are we.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know it's been a while since it happened, but here's to the success of our second event, JET.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Thank you for letting us use your place for this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't worry about it! We were already planning on staying closed today since my dad had something to do, and our regulars knew that.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: So, let's party like there's no tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, did you guys know that our event's been getting a lot of buzz?

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: It did go even better than our last one, and Vivid BAD SQUAD really stole the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Thanks! We were just glad that we managed to get Toya's song ready in time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're glad everyone liked it too since we really wanted to sing it together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, that event went way better than expected...)
The day of the event
Live House

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Our job today is to really get this place going and pass the baton to Mita and the others.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, we're going all out with our first song! You guys all ready?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
Let's go kick some butt!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm also very eager to sing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, here we go. Our second event. JET.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah, we were right to start with Toya's song. Singing it comes so naturally, as if it's helping push us forward...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Kohane's doing a good job of leading too. She's really bringing Toya's song and An's lyrics to life, but we can't let her hog all the glory.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(And the crowd...
It's just the first song, but they're already bouncing off the walls.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, we can still do better...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (A lot better...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: That event was so awesome...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: I knew that Tono was good, but I didn't realize EVER could sing those kinds of songs.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: But tonight's winner has gotta be Vivid BAD SQUAD! Their new song almost brought tears to my eyes!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: All their events are off the hook! I get really excited every time I see them perform now...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Same! And they're not kidding when they say they're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Sounds like our plan worked! Vivid BAD SQUAD really came out of the gates swinging with their first song! I'm glad we decided to have them switch spots with EVER!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yes. To be honest, Aoyagi's song took me by surprise.

rows.Speaker: EVER Member A
rows.Line: Same. I had no idea that you could come up with a track like that!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I really appreciate you saying that since I'm happy with the way it turned out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're also sorry, as we had to make you guys adjust your set lists and change our order of appearance right before the event.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: That's okay since it ended up being the correct choice. When I heard Aoyagi's song, I was convinced that it needed to be played first. It just packs such a big punch.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But EVER also did an amazing job as the headline act!
Everyone's talking about you guys' new song since it really pushed your boundaries!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you need experience in order to come up with something like that in such a short period of time.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
We do have plenty of that.
Also, as good as Aoyagi's track was, what you and Shiraishi wrote really inspired us.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Your “Silence & Action” track just seemed to keep evolving for some reason. Maybe it's because you were inspired by Aoyagi's track.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: While we were working on our track on the same theme, I think watching all of you really lit a fire under us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So, then...
It was worth going with a bit of a crazy schedule?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh! Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Sorry for being late, everyone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Arata!
It's pretty rare of you to be running late.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, I actually got a little lost.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Lost?
You mean you've never been here before?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, because I'd spent quite a bit of time away from Vivid Street. I believe Ken opened his store while I was gone, so I didn't know where it was.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But I'd like to pay my respects at some point since he's done so much for me already.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, you should stop by again sometime! I really wish my dad were here today...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I am here...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Ken...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, Dad?
I thought you were busy.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Things ended sooner than expected.
I literally walked in through the back door just now.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Long time no see, Arata.
You've grown up a lot since we last met.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
It's nice to see you again...
I apologize for not stopping by sooner.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that.
I know you're a busy person.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: More importantly, your last event was really something.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
However, we're still nowhere near our goal.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Still, we're able to approach it thanks to everyone here, especially Vivid BAD SQUAD. You and the others always do a great job of creating the energy we need.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, coming from Arata, that must mean you and the others are the real deal, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, if we didn't, there wouldn't be much point in doing these events together...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Haha. You never let up, do you?
Actually, that's kind of what makes you guys so similar.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, Arata, I'm glad to see that you found a good bunch to hang out with.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Also, please give your partner my regards. And you're welcome here anytime.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I can see Soma smiling already.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, some of the regulars here apparently went to see your last event.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: They're usually a tough crowd, but they couldn't stop praising you guys.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I remember one saying, “The way they sang shows that they've got guts. It's great to see them going all out like that.”

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Really?!
You guys hear that?! This is awesome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I couldn't be more thankful. Their word of mouth may lead to new faces coming to see us.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, so do your best for your next event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you. We will.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: That means a lot coming from you, Ken! We promise to do our best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, it does...
Not only that, our last one went so much better than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm finally starting to understand how to turn my feelings into music. So, be it events or something else, I believe I'll be able to contribute more moving forward.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. That's great to hear, but the rest of us will also need to keep doing our best. I really wanna make a track that sends shivers down people's spines.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, our individual styles aren't gonna change, but we'll come up with better and better tracks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Me too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll keep doing my best to write my own someday.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Anyway, I should head home.
Pardon the intrusion.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Our event must've gone better than we realize if Ken's willing to say what he did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But we still need to aim higher.
We shouldn't let ourselves get complacent after a couple victories.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. Which means we should start getting ready for our next event while we have everyone's attention...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: How does doing our next one at Crawl Green sound?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What?! THE Crawl Green?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Crawl Green...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nothing, don't mind me...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Wait, Tono, are you serious...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry, um... Is Crawl Green really famous or something...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right. You probably don't know about it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't know many details either, but it's a live house that's supposed to be incredibly sacred to the people of Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sacred...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, why is this live house considered sacred?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Because Crawl Green is where RADder debuted!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I heard from others that RADder was so good that they made the entire place shake. And they were just high schoolers! You wouldn't have believed it was a brand new team.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: After that event, everybody in and around this city knew who RADder was...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, that's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: However, the owner personally checks all the music beforehand.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Only the people that get the okay actually receive the privilege of performing there. It's kinda similar to COL.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
Yeah, and it's not easy.
We've tried a few times in the past but still haven't been allowed to perform there yet.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: So, everyone around here, especially people who look up to RADder or are chasing after them, sees that place as a sort of holy site! Right, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's true...

rows.Speaker: EVER Member B
rows.Line: You've performed there before, right, Tono?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, a few times.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Wait, seriously?! Does that mean if we tell that owner you're with us...?!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: No, making an appearance there is one thing, but hosting an event is an entirely different story.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: We'll have to establish a good record of putting on quality events before we can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A good record...
I guess two successful events won't be enough, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But we have the skills and talent necessary to perform there.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Which is why I've been negotiating with the owner ever since our last event ended.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So that's what you've been up to...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I did decide to chase after the same dream with all of you, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But that sounds like a lot of work...
As nice as the owner of that place is, he can be pretty stubborn.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I still haven't gotten him to say okay yet, but I have a good feeling based on how our talks have been going...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: I told him, “We're going to put on an event that's even better and more packed than the one RADder put on when they debuted!”

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Also, I'm sure we can tip the odds in our favor by showing him a video of our last event.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: That's pretty bold of you, Tono...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, but I like it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We gotta be willing to take chances if we're actually gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'd like to perform there too...!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Yeah, us too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Us. Performing there...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, nothing...
I'm all for it too.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
It'd be great to do a show there.
I've been wanting to for a really long time now!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Alright, it sounds like we're in agreement. I'll go show him a video of our last event and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Actually, Arata...
Would you mind if I tagged along?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've known the owner since I was little, so I should be able to help convince him...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Oh, that'd be great.
Then, I'll let you know next time I go to visit him.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Good luck, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can count on me!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Okay, see you all later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our after party sort of turned into a planning meeting for our next event...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but it seemed natural for us to do that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, what are you two doing after this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to start setting up all the Christmas stuff, so Kohane and I are gonna stay a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I should get home soon.
We're having our Christmas party today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?! Already?!
Isn't it a little soon for that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My dad's schedule is usually fully booked with performances during the holiday season, so we prefer to celebrate early when we can all gather.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I see.
I guess it is a busy time of year.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What about you, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm heading home. I still need to do my daily training and have to make up for the time I lost to our after party.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're going to practice after this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I get kinda antsy if I don't follow my usual routine.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's getting dark, so be careful, okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I will. Anyway, later.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Our Christmas sale is underway!
Please stop by to have a look!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Oh, congratulations! First prize is a pair of all-expenses-paid vacation passes! Please enjoy your trip!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Crawl Green, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I really wasn't expecting that name to come up...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, it's only natural since we're trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND. I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Performing there was a big goal for me...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, things are different this time. I won't drag its name through the mud this time.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have them now...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And our next event's going to be another good one.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So, I've gotta spend as much time as I can getting ready for it...)
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, An, that's it for the tree!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, nice work!
We don't have that many ornaments, and it's not that big of a tree, so putting them up is usually a quick process.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But it's so pretty and cute!
It gives the shop a nice feel.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks! My mom picked everything out for us. She'll probably be super happy when she hears that you like it so much, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. You think so...?
And it looks like the lights all turned on with no problems!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Alright, lemme go tell my dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for helping out, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're welcome! So, after this...
<Ah, so these are the decorations you all use...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hello there!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Luka! What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's almost Christmas, no?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I was just discussing with the others in SEKAI how we can transform MEIKO's cafe.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So, I decided to come and see how you all decorate things during the season.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see. Unfortunately, I'm not sure if we can help since we don't usually do much for our place.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Nonsense. That adorable little tree will make a wonderful example!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Still, you're right...
We want to decorate a little more than this... I wish there were more here that I could use as reference...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, would you like to have a look outside?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, are you sure?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. Main Street has all these really cute shops, so those might help...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hey, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh oh... Kohane, hide that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: What's wrong? You seem tense.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
N-Nothing's wrong!
Wait, actually. We finished decorating the tree!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, that's good to hear.
Then, can you start putting the outside decorations up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Fine. I guess I am better at this than you. Also, our customers really like it when I do.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I just don't have an eye for it.
Also, Kohane, thank you for helping out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: N-No, it was my pleasure. You've already done so much for me.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Still, I feel bad about having you help out...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I know. Why don't you two sing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, since I just replaced all the equipment. You're probably going to like it a lot more compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but today...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's sing for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Then, you two rest while I get everything set up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Dad!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry, Luka...
We were hoping to show you some shops with decorations that you can use for reference...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<No, don't mind me!
I'm in no hurry whatsoever.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I know. Why don't I try visiting Akito and Toya while you two sing?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Toya said that he and his family are going to be throwing their Christmas party today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, a party! That sounds lovely!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I might just have to go over and take a peek at what it's like.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank you for the tip, An, Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Have... Oh, she's already gone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Did she leave to give us some time alone?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Maybe!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At the same time, I've been wanting to sing ever since our after party...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean, Crawl Green...
It's where my dad and his team performed for the very first time. How can I not be excited?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone's been saying just that, so it must be an amazing venue. It'd be great if I... If I could perform there with you guys...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's no way we're leaving you out, Kohane! Well, to be fair, we still haven't booked the place...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: For now, let's just sing our hearts out!
Aoyagi Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Toya, would you like some coffee?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I would. Thank you, Mom.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Here, I also baked some scones and cookies.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It should be around noon in Germany right now.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, your brothers are probably getting ready for their concert.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: It's very rare for both of them to be performing in the same concert.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: By the way, Toya, how have you been lately...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We've begun hosting our own events recently, and we got to sing the song I wrote for the first time at one the other day.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Oh? You wrote a song?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: That explains why you've seemed so busy and have been coming home so late recently...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and our event ended up being very successful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But above all else...
Seeing my friends all smile filled me with quite a bit of joy.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Why do you seem so satisfied...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Of course those closest to you will be happy with what you create. There wouldn't be much point in writing a song if you couldn't do at least that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But it was a big step for me...
I have a hard time calling my song pointless.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line:
Thank you. That was very good.
I'll be returning to my room now.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: Okay, you're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm done as well.
I'll help you with the dishes.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: You will? Thank you, Toya.
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I have English homework to do.
I'll do it before I take my bath and...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hello, Toya! I let myself in♪>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. You want to decorate MEIKO's cafe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our parties are usually fairly quiet, and we don't put up decorations, so I'm not sure if I'll be able to help...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I see...
Oh, but you must've had some delicious food. Mind telling me what you ate?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We had roast chicken and rice gratin with fish. We also had some salad and pumpkin soup. My mom always puts a lot of effort into what we eat each year for this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, those all sound delicious!
I'll make sure to tell MEIKO... Thank you for sharing, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're welcome, but I wish I could help you more in terms of decorations...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Actually, you may want to pay Akito a visit...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He usually goes out for runs at this time, so you may be able to catch some outdoor illuminations.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, really?!
Then, I'll do just that.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But it's so late in the day to be training. I suppose we shouldn't expect any less from hard-working Akito.>

rows.Speaker: Toya

rows.Line: So, whenever you feel that way, don't listen to your mind. Listen to your heart. Follow it. Go after what gets your blood pumping.
